'''Nad Baron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Baron ran [[Comet Busters]], a company that specialized in destroying comets that strayed into the "safe lanes" that were used for pasage through the [[Cularin comet cloud]], in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. He was rumored to have had some shady dealings in his past.
